name: stockportfolio
description: Portfolio management with market data, valuation, charts and tolerance-band rebalancing in your browser. Quotes, asset types and price history come from a separate StockInfo API. Trade plans are simulations; no orders are placed. Portfolio data and settings are stored only in the browser, not on Unraid. No appdata volume is needed. Export backups under Settings - Backup; server backups do not include browser data. Keep the web address and host port stable when updating. Set STOCKINFO_API_URL to an address reachable from your browser. StockInfo must allow the web app origin through CORS. HTTPS pages require an HTTPS API. The container serves the web app on port 8080 without root privileges. Older images used port 80: update existing port mappings when upgrading.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the web app. The container listens on 8080. Keep the host address and port stable to retain the browser storage origin.

variables.name: StockInfo API
variables.description: URL of your StockInfo API, reachable from the browser (for example https://stockinfo.example.com). Required; no built-in public API. Restart the container after changing it.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for container logs, for example Europe/Vienna. The web interface follows the browser timezone.
